results.title: Mirage
results.overview: a soldier returns from a war in Europe, only to grow more bitter as he realises a more sinister truth.

results.title: In Sickness and In Health
results.overview: While on a romantic getaway to reconnect as a couple after her husband’s grueling exorcism, a devout wife must confront her fears that the ritual failed and her husband is still possessed.

results.title: Me Robo Al Patron Y El Negocio Tambien
results.original_title: Me Robo Al Patron Y El Negocio Tambien
results.overview: Reina, a strong and determined woman, discovers that her husband Ramiro and her best friend Angela have betrayed her. Not only are they involved in a secret relationship, but they are also planning to take control of the business she helped build from nothing.  After a violent confrontation, Reina believes she has ended their threat and walks away from her past. However, she soon learns that both are still alive and expanding their power in an attempt to dominate the territory.  Forced to return, Reina enters a ruthless conflict where pride, power, and revenge collide.  In a world where betrayal has lasting consequences, Reina must confront her past and prove that pain can be transformed into strength.

results.title: L'Ouverture
results.overview: When a little girl's puppet theater comes to life, she becomes victim to her own imagination.

results.title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
results.overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

results.title: Intérieur Sport : Fabio Quartararo - Obsession(s)
results.overview: An immersion into the 2025 season of rider Fabio Quartararo, who became the first French world champion in the premier class of MotoGP in 2021.

results.title: Magical Secret Tour
results.original_title: マジカル・シークレット・ツアー
results.overview: A mother of two who suddenly learns of her husband’s embezzlement and crushing debts; a researcher buried in debt; and an unmarried, pregnant woman with no savings. Three women who seem to have nothing to do with crime cross paths by chance and, through gold smuggling, form an unexpected bond as partners in crime. As they seize money and freedom, a revenge game begins—one that allows each of them to reclaim and rebuild their lives. The sight of women who have long gone with the flow of life, choosing to take their fate into their own hands even if it means crossing the line into crime, shines with a dazzling intensity.

results.title: Playback
results.overview: PLAYBACK is not just a biopic about Carlos Paião. It's a journey into the creative universe of one of the greatest geniuses of Portuguese music. Carlos studies Medicine, lives among books, exams, and expectations, but it is in the secret of melodies, words, and imagination that he finds the place where he truly breathes. In a country still discovering new sounds, he risks exchanging the security of a white coat for the uncertainty of stages, songs, and a dream bigger than himself. Between duty and desire, reason and intuition, fear and courage, Carlos builds a unique path, made of talent, humor, creative obsession, and an almost luminous urgency to leave his mark. PLAYBACK reveals not only the songs that made Carlos Paião an unforgettable figure in Portuguese music, but also the intimate universe from which they were born.

results.title: New Year's Repentance
results.overview: A telecomedy prepared for the New Year by the "Bu Şəhərdə" team.

results.title: Pinagkaisahan
results.overview: In a crowded public hospital, three women from different walks of life struggle against an oppressive system—each fighting for care, dignity, and the right to be seen.

results.title: Sua's Home
results.overview: 15-year-old Young-sun, abandoned by her adoptive parents and left with nowhere to go, temporarily stays at the home of Sua, whom she met as a tennis training partner. Young-sun, wanting to stay at Sua's house for a long time, tries hard to become part of the family, but Sua and her family find Young-sun burdensome.

results.title: Jumpin' Dublin
results.overview: A film about the elite set attracted to all things equestrian in Ireland which attracts luminaries such as Maeve Binchy, Mick and Bianca Jagger, Lady Iveagh, Garech Browne and Lady Zara Jellicoe at a Hunt Ball and at a dinner in Luggala Estate.

results.original_title: Pitico - Hermes Ayres Azevedo (1881-1959) - Historiador da Província

results.title: Qué más puedes hacerme
results.overview: The struggle of a poet with a wandering soul, marked by the stigma of abandonment.

results.title: I Don't Love You Anymore
results.overview: When a dead man is found face down in a couple's swimming pool, a tense police interrogation unearths dark secrets they kept hidden for years.

results.title: Instructor
results.overview: Martynas, a cocky but kind-hearted Vilnius native, loses his driver’s license due to his foolishness and arrogance. Shrugging it off, Martynas once again upsets his pregnant fiancée, who leaves him and goes to stay with her parents. In an attempt to win her back, he embarks on a seemingly ordinary journey to get his license back, during which he meets an instructor at a strange driving school—and an even stranger teacher.

results.title: Stockholm
results.overview: A young woman’s exploration of BDSM takes a dangerous turn when she’s abducted, forcing her to confront the boundaries between desire, consent and control.

results.title: The Navigator
results.overview: In 1980, Nainoa Thompson became the first Native Hawaiian in six centuries to navigate a voyaging canoe from Hawai'i to Tahiti without a compass or modern instruments. Nearly 50 years later, he embarks on the demanding open-ocean crossing one final time. He and a small crew of student navigators rely solely on the stars, nature's clues and lessons from the late master navigator Mau Piailug to guide them. As they sail 2,400 miles along the same sea road as their ancestors, they bear the responsibility of keeping this ancient knowledge alive. Naina sails not only to find an island but to search for something unseen. The Navigator reveals what is possible when we closely observe and deeply connect with the natural world.

results.title: Like A Spark
results.overview: "Like A Spark¨ follows Mathis, a fourteen-year-old boy who moves in with his estranged grandmother after his mother’s death. When he tries on his mother’s chemotherapy wig, grief becomes a tender passage toward self-expression, transformation, and connection.
